label: Monkey King
description: an agile monkey-style kung-fu fighter inspired by the Monkey King of Journey to the West: a cheeky monkey-like face with golden-tan fur on the face and arms, a thin gold circlet on the head, a red and gold armoured vest, a tiger-skin kilt over yellow trousers, black boots, holding a long red staff with gold bands at both ends

portrait.prompt: Now something different: NOT a sprite sheet. Draw ONE single square character-select portrait (one image, no grid, no frames) of the same character ({description}), in the same pixel-art style but more detailed: chest-up close-up, the face large with a cocky grin, the gold-banded staff resting on one shoulder, one hand shading the eyes as if spotting a rival, the head turned three-quarters toward the right, dramatic rim lighting. Solid warm orange clouds background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: A bouncy, crouched monkey-style kung-fu, staff held across the body fighting stance. The feet stay in the same place in every frame; only the body bobs and breathes.
poses: rest pose in the guard stance
body dips about 2 pixels, shoulders relax
returning to the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A guarded step toward the RIGHT. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place).
poses: contact: front (right) foot stepping forward, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A retreating step: still FACING RIGHT toward the enemy, guard up, stepping backward (to the left). The character stays centred in its cell.
poses: contact: back (left) foot placed behind, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: Six clearly DIFFERENT poses going from standing down to kneeling; the feet stay on the same ground line.
poses: standing guard stance exactly as in the reference, full height
half squat, knees bent, head clearly lower than in frame 1
dropping to one knee, the back knee almost touching the ground
kneeling on one knee, guard up, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line. Keep the character horizontally centred in its cell.
poses: anticipation: deep crouch, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, feet leaving the ground
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees tucked
landing: feet back on the ground line, knees bent absorbing the impact

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to raise the guard
the staff held vertically in front of the face
block held: the staff held vertically in front of the face and chest, body braced

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the ground line. Goes from standing to a LOW crouching block held from frame 3 onward.
poses: crouching low, the guard lowering in front of the knees
block held: deep low crouch kneeling on one knee, guarding the shins, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Struck in the face from the RIGHT, recoiling backward to the LEFT; feet stay near the ground line.
poses: impact: head snaps back, eyes shut
maximum recoil: torso bent far back, one foot sliding
back in the guard stance with a pained face

actions.label: Staff Jab
actions.note: A fast straight staff jab toward the RIGHT at head height, the staff pushed forward with both hands. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: strike: the staff tip jabbing forward to the RIGHT at head height
full extension: the staff tip jabbing forward to the RIGHT at head height, a short white impact streak touching it

actions.label: Tail Sweep
actions.note: A low spinning staff sweep along the ground toward the RIGHT, aimed at the ankles, the body crouched low. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: wind-up, body turning, the attack chambered
strike: the staff sweeping low to the RIGHT just above the ground, a motion arc touching it
full extension: the staff sweeping low to the RIGHT just above the ground

actions.label: Golden Eyes
actions.note: Powering up in place; feet stay planted. His eyes glow gold and gold dust with small white cloud puffs swirls around him and the staff (gold and white only). The aura always touches the body (no separate floating sparks).

actions.label: Thousand Staff Storm
actions.note: IMPORTANT: NINE frames in a 3x3 grid (3 columns and 3 ROWS). A three-hit combo toward the RIGHT. The strike frames are 3, 5 and 7; frames 4, 6 and 8 are transitions. Gold dust and white cloud puffs follow the staff (gold and white only). Effects always touch the fighter or weapon.
poses: first hit: a rapid spinning staff strike with a gold arc toward the RIGHT
second hit: a leaping staff swing with gold dust toward the RIGHT
third hit, the finisher: a huge overhead staff slam releasing a gold shockwave along the ground toward the RIGHT, a large burst

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: Hit from the RIGHT, falling backward to the LEFT, ending lying on the back with the head to the left and the feet to the right. The lying body must fit inside its cell.
poses: hitting the ground on the back, small dust puff touching the body
lying flat, head to the left, feet to the right
